interpretation.supervision: All methods see the same 64 task responses and 20 preservation responses. One task and one preservation example per optimizer step. Discovery uses eight task examples, no validation/test data.
interpretation.selection: Within each method/seed choose the lower target_val mean completion NLL; ties choose lower learning rate. Save selection before reviewing target_test, scope_test and utility_test. No test performance selects a rate.
interpretation.learning: A selected LoRA that improves fresh-name task correctness by at least 8/64, without losing more than two semantically correct solved-family controls, establishes a promising learning pilot. Otherwise analyze outputs/learning traces rather than announcing a method.
interpretation.method: Report Fisher, both random seeds and LoRA separately, all rates. No superiority claim from one pilot; require fresh wording transfer, preservation and total costs. Test phrasings and exposed diagnostics are distinguished.
interpretation.utility: Utility is supplemental and reviewed semantically. The old exact-string utility gate is disabled rather than treating full-sentence aliases as incapable. Empty/weak base-correct utility coverage invalidates preservation claims, not the relation-learning measurement.
interpretation.limits: Synthetic, four templates, two task families; correlated conditions. No natural-document or second-model robustness established. No automatic promotion to library default.
